name: AICB-Benchmark-Vik-SFT
description: AICB-Benchmark-Vik-SFT is a text benchmark designed to evaluate instruction-following and conversational quality for models fine-tuned with supervised data. It measures how well models respond to a variety of prompts, including knowledge, reasoning, and dialogue tasks. The suite is intended to assess improvements from SFT-style training.
reputation: A small community benchmark on Hugging Face used primarily by its author and a limited set of researchers.
